svg.title: Original alpha-band PLV matrix and connectivity graph
svg.desc: Original single-subject alpha PLV matrix and top-5-percent graph, recovered from saved PNG outputs in cells 8 and 9 of analysis_alzheimer.ipynb at commit 3a67f653e0f0a9027375cd711dd7ac0c6970486c. Original labels and plotted values are preserved. This is an exploratory single-subject result, not final cohort inference.
